source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Wistron-BIOS-00004-V003 occurs in two workbook rows; this AFUEFI-upgrade variant is bound to Functionality row 337 and its hash.

source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the latest version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS should be flashed without errors
2. Version should be shown correctly in BIOS and OS

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves exact image/shell dependency and bricking risk but under-specifies region flags, recovery and BIOS-menu acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / IMPROVED; adds board/image/tool validation, stable power, OOB recovery and BIOS/OS evidence.

original_test_intent: Upgrade the System ROM with the platform-approved AMI AFU EFI image and `/P /B /N /ME` policy, reboot to activate, and verify the target BIOS version in both BIOS Setup and OS without flash errors.
original_method: Validate board identity, image/tool provenance and every region flag, establish stable power, bootable EFI access and OOB recovery, execute the exact flash without interruption, reboot only after success, then collect OS evidence and a human-confirmed BIOS Setup version/state.
manual_activity: The source requires interaction in an EFI environment and verification of the displayed version in BIOS Setup. An engineer must supervise the destructive flash and personally confirm the BIOS-menu evidence; the agent can prepare media/commands, collect OS/BMC evidence and analyze screenshots but cannot claim that core visual acceptance.
required_inputs: Exact board/product identity and current BIOS/ME/configuration baseline
Signed/checksummed target BIOS image and release notes
Platform-approved AFUEFI version and explicit rationale for `/P /B /N /ME`
Bootable EFI media/shell path, stable AC and maintenance window
Recovery image/procedure, BMC/OOB access and final configuration policy
safety_requirements: Do not infer `latest`; bind the image to the exact board and approved target version.
Validate every region flag because `/B`, `/N` and `/ME` may alter boot block, NVRAM and management firmware.
Never interrupt power or reboot during write; preserve complete AFU status and stop on the first error.
No automatic retry, alternate image/flags, blind power-cycle or recovery flash.
After activation verify boot, ME, TPM/Secure Boot and required settings as well as version.
agent_execution_scope: Validate identities, hashes/signatures, flag policy, stable power and recovery readiness.
Stage the exact tool/image and command and capture AFUEFI, reboot, OS/BMC and screenshot evidence under engineer supervision.
Analyze post-flash health and prepare Tool Result without claiming BIOS-menu observation or PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve and supervise the destructive EFI flash and any required shell/media interaction.
Observe BIOS Setup and confirm displayed version and required settings.
Direct recovery if needed and issue formal PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves the source command and risk but post-boot dmidecode alone cannot satisfy the BIOS Setup criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep `afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME` only when platform documentation approves the exact tool/image/regions; do not modernize or remove flags generically.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/latest intent, exact AFUEFI command and flags, reboot, BIOS-and-OS verification, script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: ORIGINAL AFUEFI PATH RETAINED WITH HUMAN BIOS-SETUP ACCEPTANCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an artifact manifest and preflight gate for board/image/tool/regions, capture uninterrupted flash telemetry and boot health, and pair OS version evidence with a timestamped human-confirmed BIOS Setup record.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact platform for which the image and AFUEFI region policy are approved.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record AFUEFI build/hash, BIOS image/hash/signature, board revision, current/target BIOS/ME, BMC and EFI environment.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI firmware update procedure supplied with the approved package and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds supply-chain, region, recovery and configuration-preservation gates without changing the source flash method.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote OS version cannot replace the required BIOS Setup display check.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve a different target image or supported flags. The report must name actual regions written and cannot claim full `/P /B /N /ME` coverage if narrowed.
expected_evidence: Board identity, baseline BIOS/ME/settings, AFUEFI/image hashes/signatures and region approval
EFI staging, exact command, full flash output/status and stable-power evidence
Controlled reboot and OS/BMC boot/ME/TPM/Secure-Boot/log health
Timestamped BIOS Setup version/settings observed and signed by the engineer

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria consistently require AFUEFI upgrade and BIOS/OS version verification; missing platform artifacts are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The task is clear but the core completion includes a human EFI/BIOS-menu action. Lack of current project artifacts does not make the library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its destructive/manual insight but strengthens flags, recovery and dual-location evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps all safety controls and changes classification to MANUAL ONLY because BIOS Setup display confirmation is a required core acceptance, not merely package setup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent assistance and Tool Result from the engineer's physical/visual acceptance and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an OS-only version check from falsely satisfying the BIOS Setup criterion and prevents generic use of destructive AFU region flags.
independent_technical_reasoning: Although much of the workflow is automatable, the source explicitly requires EFI-shell interaction and BIOS Setup display verification. Under the locked V3.1 manual-observation rule, the formal class is MANUAL ONLY; agent support remains extensive.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not rerun AFUEFI, alter image/flags, reboot/power-cycle after a flash error or initiate recovery without a newly approved engineer-directed plan.
